src: legend colors s from the solid vertical bars, read left-to-right
dst: consecutive vertical sprite slots d in the stack, ordered top-to-bottom
match_cond: rank(s) == rank(d); existing same-mask sprites fix the shared stack anchor
transform: erase the legend; fill each slot with the shared sprite mask recolored to its assigned legend color
symbol_instructions: the color-bar legend gives the complete stack color order
